dialogue.content: ぬい様今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Ms. Nui, thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: ご準備出来ましたら始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Once you're ready, we'll begin.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Likewise, thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 少しお待ちくださいませ
dialogue.English: Please give me a moment.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: お待たせしました。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm ready to begin.

dialogue.content: では始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Alright, let's get started then.

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です差し支えなければ、性別と年齢を教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: 30歳女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 30-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 上司との関係で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm having trouble with my relationship with my boss.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね心配ですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be worrying.

dialogue.content: 具体的にどのような状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically about the situation?

dialogue.content: 上司が横暴で、怖いんです。
dialogue.English: My boss is overbearing, and I'm scared of her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか・・どんなことがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... What kinds of things have happened?

dialogue.content: 怖いんですねどんなことがあったのでしょうか
dialogue.English: You feel scared. What has been happening?

dialogue.content: トラブルがあった訳じゃないんですけど、すごく一方的で意見を押し通すので、なんか何も言えなくなります
dialogue.English: It's not that there's been a specific incident, but she's very one-sided and always pushes her own opinions, which makes me feel like I can't say anything.

dialogue.content: それは困ってしまいますね
dialogue.English: That sounds very difficult.

dialogue.content: ちなみにどのようお仕事をされているのでしょうか
dialogue.English: By the way, what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 事務職です
dialogue.English: I work in administration.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね上司の方の性別は？
dialogue.English: I see. And what is your boss's gender?

dialogue.content: 女性です
dialogue.English: She's a woman.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね毎日お仕事をしていて、一番お辛いと思われるのはどんなことを言われる時でしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. In your day-to-day work, what does she say that you find most difficult?

dialogue.content: ｢じゃあこれでいきましょう｣って言われるときですね。
dialogue.English: It's when she says, 'Alright, let's go with this.'

dialogue.content: というのは・・あなたの意見などあまり聞かずに？ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that mean... she says that without really listening to your opinions?

dialogue.content: そうですね。せっかく意見を言っても、結局は上司の言う通りになるので…
dialogue.English: That's right. Even when I take the time to share my opinion, in the end, it always goes her way...

dialogue.content: それはおお辛いですよね
dialogue.English: That must be really tough.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: その上司とは、どのくらいの期間一緒にお仕事をされていますか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been working with this boss?

dialogue.content: 1年くらいです
dialogue.English: About a year.

dialogue.content: 1年まえからずっと我慢されていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: So you've been putting up with this for a whole year.

dialogue.content: そうですね、なんだか疲れちゃいました
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m just worn out.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・自分の思い通りにできないなんて・・しんどくなりますよね
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It must be exhausting not being able to do things the way you think is best.

dialogue.content: 私が意見を出す意味ってあるのかなって思います
dialogue.English: It makes me wonder if there’s any point in sharing my ideas.

dialogue.content: 同僚の方々とかには相談とかされているのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Have you talked about this with any of your colleagues?

dialogue.content: うーん、なんかみんな私と同じような感じで諦めてるので、私もそうすればいいのかなって思います。相談してもいい方向に向くとは考えられません
dialogue.English: Well, it seems like everyone feels the same and has given up, so I wonder if I should do the same. I can’t imagine that talking about it would lead to anything better.

dialogue.content: 上司が違う同僚もいるし、話しやすい人且つわかって貰えそうな人は見当たりません
dialogue.English: There are colleagues with different bosses, but I can't find anyone who seems easy to talk to and who would understand.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・せっかく意見をいっても・・否定されてしまうとやる気もきないですし、わかってもらえないって思われるのですね
dialogue.English: I see... So when you make the effort to share an opinion and it gets shut down, you lose motivation and feel like you're not being understood.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに今のお仕事は何年目くらいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how many years have you been at your current job?

dialogue.content: 3年目です
dialogue.English: This is my third year.

dialogue.content: 長く続けてらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: You’ve been there for quite a while.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのようなところが気に入って入られたんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What was it about the job that you liked when you started?

dialogue.content: 今のお仕事を選ばれたんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What made you choose this job?

dialogue.content: 事務職って楽そうだしいいかなと思って入りました
dialogue.English: I thought administrative work seemed easy and nice, so I joined.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 今の上司と一緒でに時は、楽しくお仕事されていたんですね
dialogue.English: When you weren't with your current boss, you enjoyed your work, right?

dialogue.content: ↑一緒でない時は
dialogue.English: —I mean, when you were not working with your current supervisor.

dialogue.content: それなりに楽しかったですね
dialogue.English: It was reasonably enjoyable.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: そのころは自分の意見とかは言ったりはできていたのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Back then, were you able to express your own opinions?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, I was.

dialogue.content: ではなおさら、今の状況は辛くなってしまいますね
dialogue.English: That makes the current situation all the more difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: Yes, it does...

dialogue.content: もともとは、あなたは自分の意見や提案をしっかり言える方なんですね
dialogue.English: So, you're someone who is naturally able to state your opinions and suggestions clearly.

dialogue.content: こうした方がいいんじゃないか、とか言えてました
dialogue.English: I used to be able to say things like, “Wouldn’t it be better to do it this way?”

dialogue.content: なるほど・・そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: 今のあなたの状況では、あなたらしいお仕事ができてないっていう感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does it feel like in your current situation, you're not able to work in a way that feels true to yourself?

dialogue.content: そうですね…自分らしさが何なのかはわかりませんが、しんどいです
dialogue.English: I suppose so... I'm not sure what 'being true to myself' is, but it's just exhausting.

dialogue.content: しんどいですよね・・質問をかえますねあなたは今のお仕事がどんなふうだったらいいなと思いますか？
dialogue.English: It is exhausting... Let me ask a different question. How would you like your current job to be?

dialogue.content: もう少し上司が自分の意見に耳を貸してくれたらいいなと思います
dialogue.English: I wish my boss would listen to my opinions a bit more.

dialogue.content: そうですよねそう思いますよね
dialogue.English: Right. I can certainly understand why you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここまでお話を伺って感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I shared some of my impressions from what you've told me so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: あなたは事務職が楽しいと思って今のお仕事を選び、3年間も頑張ってきましたあなたはとてもお仕事を誠実に目標をもってしっかりされる方だと思います
dialogue.English: You chose this job thinking you'd enjoy administrative work, and you've worked hard at it for three years. It seems to me that you're a very sincere person who approaches work with clear goals and dedication.

dialogue.content: 自分の意見をもち上司にしっかり意見をいって頑張っておられたのに、1年まえからの上司は横暴で一方的に押し切ってしまうタイプで、あなたは辛てしんどくなっています
dialogue.English: You had your own opinions and shared them clearly with your supervisor, but the supervisor you’ve had for the past year is overbearing and tends to push through unilaterally, which has been painful and exhausting for you.

dialogue.content: ひとつ提案なのですが、上司のコミュニケーションパターンを変えてみたらいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I have one suggestion: how would it be to try adjusting the communication pattern with your supervisor?

dialogue.content: 変えてみる…というのは、どのようなことでしょうか
dialogue.English: Change it... what do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: 例えば、業務をしっかり遂行したいので、それに今のやり方ではなくこんなやり方もあるのでは？とか・・あくまで仕事のパフォーマンスをあげるような具体的な提案とかは可能でしょうか？
dialogue.English: For example, you could frame it as wanting to perform your duties well, and suggest that 'instead of the current method, perhaps there's this other way?' Is it possible to make concrete suggestions that are strictly about improving work performance?

dialogue.content: 具体的な伝え方です
dialogue.English: It's about the specific way you present it.

dialogue.content: が、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 今までも、｢こうした方が無駄なく進むのではないか｣と言ったりもしましたが、全部否定されました。上司は自分と違う意見が気に入らないのです、きっと…
dialogue.English: I've tried that before, saying things like, 'Wouldn't this be more efficient?' but she rejected all of it. I'm sure she just doesn't like opinions that are different from her own...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・固定観念が強い方なんですね
dialogue.English: I see... She seems to be someone with very fixed ideas.

dialogue.content: それは困ってしまいますね
dialogue.English: That's certainly a difficult situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 少しづつでも、改善されるような提案も難しいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it difficult even to make suggestions that would lead to small, gradual improvements?

dialogue.content: 上手くいかないですね…否定されるのも怖いので、言いたくないです。
dialogue.English: It doesn’t go well... I’m afraid of being rejected, so I don’t want to speak up.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね否定されるのでは嫌になってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. It's disheartening to be rejected like that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ほかの部署に異動するとかは難しいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be difficult to transfer to another department?

dialogue.content: うーん、そればっかりはわからないです。希望を言うとかもないですし。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I’m not sure about that. There isn’t really a process for expressing preferences.

dialogue.content: あまりに否定されるようなことが続きあなたのが辛くなってしまうのは心配です
dialogue.English: I'm concerned that if this constant rejection continues, it will become too hard for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もっと上の役職の方などに相談されるとかもできそうではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be possible to consult with someone in a higher position?

dialogue.content: あなた一人で抱え込んでしまっているのも、理不尽なことと思います
dialogue.English: I think it's unfair that you have to carry this burden all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 普段ほとんど関わりがないので、話しかけづらいですね…取締役とかなので。
dialogue.English: I hardly interact with them, so it’s hard to approach them... They’re directors and such.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 改善されるの難しそうなんですね
dialogue.English: It sounds difficult to make improvements.

dialogue.content: はい。上司の性格なので、言われたから変わるとかではないと思います・
dialogue.English: Yes. It's her personality, so I don't think she's the type to change just because someone tells her to.

dialogue.content: 上司が変わらないのであれば、あなた自信が変わっていくこともできるのでは？と思いますがいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: If your supervisor won’t change, perhaps you could consider changing yourself—what do you think?

dialogue.content: どのように変わればいいのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: How should I change?

dialogue.content: あなたはお仕事も前向きに取り組んでおられる方だと思います
dialogue.English: I believe you're someone who approaches work with a positive attitude.

dialogue.content: 否定されることは確かに怖いことでもありますが、決してあきらめずに提案し続ける勇気が大切かと思います
dialogue.English: It's true that being rejected is scary, but I think it's important to have the courage to continue making suggestions without giving up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 否定されるのは怖いですが、決して諦めてはいけないと思います
dialogue.English: It's scary to be rejected, but I believe it's important not to give up.

dialogue.content: いつか上司が自分の意見を受け入れてくれる日が来るのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Will a day ever come when my boss accepts my opinion?

dialogue.content: 上司から余計に目の敵にされたり、意固地になりそうですが…
dialogue.English: I worry she might single me out even more or become more stubborn...

dialogue.content: はい、辛抱強くコミュニケーションの伝え方なども工夫しながら伝えていけば一気に変わるのは難しいかも、しれませんが、きっと少しでもやりやすい環境になるのでは、ないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, it might be difficult to change things all at once, but if you persevere and find creative ways to communicate, don't you think you could create an environment that's at least a little easier to work in?

dialogue.content: わかりました、やってみます
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll try.

dialogue.content: 提案の仕方も、必ず私はこう思いますが、いかがでしょうか？と必ず上司に意見を聞くことがポイントです
dialogue.English: When you make a suggestion, the key is to always frame it as, 'This is what I think, but what are your thoughts?' and be sure to ask for her opinion.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: この提案についてどうおもわれますか？と謙虚にきいてみてください
dialogue.English: Try asking humbly, “What do you think about this proposal?”

dialogue.content: そうですね、そうしてみます
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll try that.

dialogue.content: きっと少しずつ変わっていくと思います
dialogue.English: I'm sure things will start to change, little by little.

dialogue.content: あなたが、あなたらしい生き方ができますように応援しています
dialogue.English: I'll be rooting for you to be able to live in a way that feels true to yourself.

dialogue.content: 無理をせす焦らすに頑張ってくださいね
dialogue.English: Take your time and don't push yourself too hard.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お時間がすぎてしまい申し訳ありません
dialogue.English: I’m sorry we’ve run over time.

dialogue.content: いえ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, not at all. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談はこれで大丈夫そうでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you feel like we've covered what you wanted to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: ではこれで終了にさせていただきますね相談にきて来て頂いてありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Alright, we'll end the session here. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （では終了ボタン押させていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (Okay, I'm going to press the end button now.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much!)
